mc.world.level.storage.ValueInput.name: net.minecraft.world.level.storage.ValueInput
mc.world.level.storage.ValueInput.note: 1.21.6 引入的持久化读取抽象：input.getIntOr(key, 默认)、input.read(key, codec)、input.child(key) 等，替代直接读 CompoundTag

mc.world.level.storage.ValueOutput.name: net.minecraft.world.level.storage.ValueOutput
mc.world.level.storage.ValueOutput.note: 1.21.6 引入的持久化写入抽象：output.putInt(key, v)、output.store(key, codec, v)、output.child(key) 等，替代直接写 CompoundTag

mc.client.renderer.RenderPipelines.name: net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderPipelines
mc.client.renderer.RenderPipelines.note: 原版渲染管线常量（GUI 贴图常用 RenderPipelines.GUI_TEXTURED）

mc.blockentity.BlockEntity.name: net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity
mc.blockentity.BlockEntity.note: 1.21.6 起持久化改为 loadAdditional(ValueInput) / saveAdditional(ValueOutput)，不再直接拿 CompoundTag 与 HolderLookup.Provider

mc.entity.player.ServerPlayer.name: net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer
mc.entity.player.ServerPlayer.note: 1.21.6 起 server 字段改为私有（用 getServer()），serverLevel() 已移除（level() 直接返回 ServerLevel）；打开菜单仍用 serverPlayer.openMenu(...)

mc.client.gui.GuiGraphics.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics
mc.client.gui.GuiGraphics.note: 1.21.6 GUI 改为先收集后绘制：blit/blitSprite/fill 首参为 RenderPipeline（如 RenderPipelines.GUI_TEXTURED），pose() 返回 Matrix3x2fStack（2D 变换，pushMatrix/popMatrix），颜色需带 alpha（0xFFRRGGBB），悬浮提示改为 setTooltipForNextFrame

forge.util.INBTSerializable.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.common.util.ValueIOSerializable
forge.util.INBTSerializable.note: NeoForge 21.6 移除 INBTSerializable，替代接口 ValueIOSerializable：serialize(ValueOutput) / deserialize(ValueInput)，实现类需改写读写逻辑

forge.Mod.EventBusSubscriber.name: net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber
forge.Mod.EventBusSubscriber.note: NeoForge 21.6 起 @EventBusSubscriber 去掉 bus 属性（Mod 总线事件按类型自动分派），删除 bus = ... 即可

forge.event.RenderLevelStageEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderLevelStageEvent
forge.event.RenderLevelStageEvent.note: NeoForge 21.6 起按阶段拆为子事件：监听 RenderLevelStageEvent.AfterEntities / AfterTranslucentBlocks / AfterLevel 等，不再比较 getStage()

forge.event.RegisterGuiOverlaysEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RegisterGuiLayersEvent
forge.event.RegisterGuiOverlaysEvent.note: NeoForge 21.6 起 layer 参数类型为 net.neoforged.neoforge.client.gui.GuiLayer（(guiGraphics, deltaTracker) -> ...，签名同旧 lambda）
